skill.name: The joining word that gives the right meaning (because, although, unless, until)
skill.why: Readers can't see inside your head. The joining word tells them exactly how your two ideas connect.
skill.how: Ask what the link is: a reason (because), a surprise (although), a time (until) or a condition (unless). Then pick the word that says it.

iDo.text: I wore my boots ___ it was muddy.
lines: Joining words aren't just glue. Each one tells the reader how two ideas connect.
Here I ask: what's the link between boots and mud? The mud is the reason I wore boots. A reason means because.
Now flip it: I wore my thongs ___ it was muddy. Thongs in the mud? That's a surprise. A surprise means although.
So before I choose, I always ask: reason, surprise, time or condition?

weDo.text: The shop stays open ___ the last customer leaves.
weDo.hint: Is this about a reason, a surprise or a time?
weDo.success: Until is about time. The shop stays open up to the moment the last customer leaves.

options.reason: Because would make the customer leaving the reason the shop is open. It's really about when it closes.
Although sets up a surprise, and nothing here is surprising.

weDo.text: Mo laughed ___ the joke was terrible.
weDo.hint: Would a terrible joke normally make you laugh?
weDo.success: Although. You wouldn't expect anyone to laugh at a terrible joke, so it's a surprise.

options.reason: Because would mean the joke being terrible is why Mo laughed. Terrible jokes don't usually get laughs, so it's a surprise.
Unless sets a condition, as in 'only if not'. Mo already laughed, so there's no condition.

creature.name: Hingeling
creature.blurb: A hermit crab that joins two broken shells into one. It only holds if you choose the right hinge.

encounters.frame: A Hingeling is stuck between two halves of a shell.
encounters.text: We stayed inside ___ it was pouring with rain.
encounters.success: Because gives the reason. The rain is why you stayed in.

options.reason: Although sets up a surprise, but staying in when it rains is no surprise.
Until is about time. It would mean you stayed inside only up to the moment it rained.

encounters.frame: Tully is reading out a footy report, but a word has fallen out.
encounters.text: Jai kept practising his kicks ___ he could hit the post.
encounters.success: Until is about time. He practised up to the point where he could hit the post.

options.reason: Because would mean hitting the post is why he practised. It's the other way round: practising got him there.
Although signals a surprise, and there's nothing surprising here.

encounters.frame: Wren found a sign at the penguin enclosure with a hole in it.
encounters.text: You can't feed the penguins ___ the keeper says it's OK.
encounters.success: Unless sets the condition. Feeding is only allowed if the keeper says yes.

options.reason: Because would make the keeper's OK the reason you can't feed them. That makes no sense.
Although would mean you still can't feed them even when the keeper says it's OK. The OK is the condition, so you need unless.

encounters.frame: The Hingeling holds out its pieces. Build the sentence.
encounters.prompt: Tap the pieces in order to make a sentence that makes sense.
encounters.success: Because gives the reason. Pelting rain is exactly why you'd wear a raincoat.

accept: Mia wore her raincoat because the rain was pelting down.
body.reason: Ask why Mia wore her raincoat. Pelting rain is the reason, so it needs the reason word.

encounters.frame: Mo's diary has a word that doesn't make sense.
encounters.prompt: Tap the word that gives the wrong meaning, then choose a better one.
encounters.success: Because. Being starving is the reason Mo ate early.

parts.reason: Ate is fine. Look for the word that joins the two ideas.
Early is fine. Look for the word that joins the two ideas.
Starving is fine. Look for the word that joins the two ideas.

options.reason: Until is about time. It would mean Mo ate only up to the moment of being starving.
Unless sets a condition. Mo already ate, so there's no condition to meet.

encounters.frame: Two shells, two kinds of sentence. Help the Hingeling sort them.
encounters.prompt: Match each sentence to the right shell.
encounters.success: Because answers 'why?'. Although warns you a surprise is coming.

items.text: We left early because the bus was full.
items.reason: 'The bus was full' is why you left early, so it's a reason.

items.text: We left early although the party was fun.
items.reason: You wouldn't expect to leave a fun party early, so it's a surprise.

items.text: The game stopped because it was raining.
items.reason: The rain is why the game stopped, so it's a reason.

items.text: Ava smiled although her knee hurt.
items.reason: A sore knee doesn't usually make you smile, so it's a surprise.

encounters.frame: Gus has stuck a safety sign to the lab door. One word has melted off.
encounters.text: Nobody is allowed in the slime lab ___ they are wearing goggles.
encounters.success: Unless sets the condition. You only get in if you're wearing goggles.

options.reason: Because would mean wearing goggles is the reason nobody's allowed in. Goggles should get you in, not keep you out.
Although would mean you're kept out even when you wear goggles. The goggles are the condition, so you need unless.

encounters.frame: Gus is writing up his latest experiment.
encounters.text: ___ the slime smelled like old socks, Gus happily took a big sniff.
encounters.success: Although. A sock smell should put you off, so happily sniffing it is a surprise.

options.reason: Because would make the sock smell the reason he sniffed happily. 'Happily' tells you he did it in spite of the smell.
Unless sets a condition. Gus already sniffed it, so there's nothing to wait for.

encounters.frame: A message is crackling in from the Mars rover team.
encounters.text: The rover will keep sending pictures ___ its batteries run flat.
encounters.success: Until is about time. The pictures keep coming up to the moment the batteries die.

options.reason: Because would make flat batteries the reason it sends pictures. Flat batteries would stop it.
Although sets up a surprise. Here the sentence is telling you when the pictures will stop.

encounters.frame: The Hingeling has a sentence in pieces from Tully's match report.
encounters.prompt: Tap the pieces in order to make a sentence that makes sense.
encounters.success: Even though. Aching legs would normally make you stop, so keeping going is a surprise.

accept: The players kept running even though their legs were aching.
body.reason: Aching legs would normally make you stop. Keeping going is a surprise, so you need the surprise word.

encounters.frame: Zed's beach plan has a word that gives the wrong meaning.
encounters.prompt: Tap the word that gives the wrong meaning, then choose a better one.
encounters.success: If. Going to the beach depends on the rain stopping, so it's a condition.

parts.reason: Go is fine. Look for the word that joins the two ideas.
Beach is fine. Look for the word that joins the two ideas.
Raining is fine. Look for the word that joins the two ideas.

options.reason: Because would mean the rain stopping is why you're allowed to go. The trip depends on it, which is a condition.
Even though sets up a surprise, but going to the beach when the rain stops is no surprise.

encounters.frame: Three shells this time. The Hingeling needs each half-sentence in the right one.
encounters.prompt: Match each half-sentence to the right shell.
encounters.success: Reason answers 'why?', time answers 'when?', and a condition means 'only if'.

items.reason: 'Because' gives the reason why something happened.
'Unless' means it only happens if you don't meet the condition.
'If' sets a condition that has to be true first.

encounters.frame: Captain's log, written in a hurry. One word is smudged.
encounters.text: The ferry left without us ___ we were only two minutes late.
encounters.success: Even though. 'Only two minutes' tells you it shouldn't have mattered, so the ferry leaving is a surprise.

options.reason: The word 'only' is a clue: being two minutes late shouldn't have been enough to miss it. That makes it a surprise, not a reason.
Unless sets a condition, but the ferry had already left. There's nothing left to depend on.
Until is about time running up to a point. It would mean the ferry stopped leaving once we were late.

encounters.frame: The Hingeling found an overdue notice from the island library.
encounters.text: ___ you return the book by Friday, you will have to pay a fine.
encounters.success: Unless. The fine only happens if the book doesn't come back, so it's a condition.

options.reason: Although would mean you pay the fine even after returning the book. The return is the condition that saves you.
Because would make returning the book the reason you get fined. Returning it is what stops the fine.
Since gives a reason or a starting time. Returning the book is neither: it's the condition.

encounters.frame: Wren is writing up last night's rescue.
encounters.text: Wren stayed with the injured wombat ___ the vet finally arrived at midnight.
encounters.success: Until. She stayed up to the moment the vet arrived. 'Finally' tells you it was a long wait.

options.reason: Although sets up a surprise, but there's no surprise in staying with a hurt animal until help comes.
Unless sets a condition. The vet did arrive, so the sentence is about time, not a condition.
Because would make the vet arriving the reason she stayed. She stayed to look after the wombat, and the vet arriving is when she could stop.

encounters.frame: Indi is labelling a poster for the reef centre.
encounters.text: Dolphins breathe air like we do, ___ they spend their whole lives in the water.
encounters.success: Although. You'd expect an air-breather to live on land, so living in water is a surprise.

options.reason: So would mean breathing air is why dolphins live in water. It's actually the surprising part.
Unless sets a condition, but this sentence is stating two facts that seem to clash.
Because would make living in water the reason they breathe air. The two facts clash rather than explain each other.

encounters.frame: Tully's weather report has fallen to bits.
encounters.prompt: Tap the pieces in order to make a sentence that makes sense.
encounters.success: Although. Promised storms should have stopped the match, so going ahead is a surprise.

accept: The match went ahead as planned although the forecast had promised storms.
body.reason: Storms usually stop a match. A match going ahead despite the forecast is a surprise, not a reason.

encounters.frame: A sign at the fair has the wrong joining word. Fix it for Indi.
encounters.prompt: Tap the word that gives the wrong meaning, then choose a better one.
encounters.success: Although. Never painting a mural before should make it harder, so winning is a surprise.

parts.reason: Never is fine. It's the clue that makes the result surprising.
Mural is fine. Look for the word that joins the two ideas.
Best is fine. Look for the word that joins the two ideas.

options.reason: Unless sets a condition, but the mural is already done and judged.
Until is about time running up to a point. The sentence is about a surprising result.

encounters.frame: A torn page from an explorer's journal washes up on the reef.
encounters.text: The expedition pressed on towards the summit ___ two of the climbers had already turned back with frostbite.
encounters.success: Even though. Losing two climbers to frostbite should stop an expedition, so pressing on is a surprise.

options.reason: So that gives a purpose. The climbers turning back wasn't the goal of pressing on.
Unless sets a condition, but both things have already happened. The sentence is about a surprising choice.
Because would make the frostbite the reason they pressed on. You'd expect frostbite to make a team turn back.

encounters.frame: The Hingeling is reading a museum display about new discoveries.
encounters.text: Scientists cannot name a new species ___ they have compared it with every closely related animal on record.
encounters.success: Unless. Naming is only allowed once the comparison is done, so it's a condition.

options.reason: Although would mean they still can't name it after comparing. The comparison is what allows the name.
Because would make the comparing the reason they can't name it. Comparing is what makes naming possible.
Whereas compares two different things side by side. Here, one thing depends on the other.

encounters.frame: Zed found a creepy fact on an old poster.
encounters.text: Some people find spiders terrifying, ___ others keep them as pets and even give them names.
encounters.success: Whereas. It sets two groups side by side to show how different they are.

options.reason: Because would make some people's fear the reason others keep spiders as pets. The two groups aren't connected like that.
Unless sets a condition. Neither group depends on the other.
Until is about time running up to a point. These are two groups of people being compared.

encounters.frame: A concert review has a gap. Read the whole sentence before you choose.
encounters.text: The orchestra kept playing ___ the lights had failed, because every musician knew the piece by heart.
encounters.success: Even though. Playing in the dark is surprising, and the end of the sentence explains how they managed it.

options.reason: Until would mean they stopped when the lights failed. The end of the sentence says they could keep going because they knew it by heart.
Unless sets a condition, but the lights had already failed. The sentence explains how they kept playing anyway.
So that gives a purpose. The orchestra didn't keep playing in order to make the lights fail.

encounters.frame: Mission control's announcement has been scrambled.
encounters.prompt: Tap the pieces in order to make a sentence that makes sense.
encounters.success: Provided that. The launch depends on the weather, which makes it a condition.

accept: Provided that the weather holds, the launch will go ahead at dawn.
body.reason: The launch depends on the weather holding. That's a condition, so it needs a condition word. 'Although' would set up a clash, but good weather and a launch don't clash.

encounters.frame: Three shells, and the Hingeling is getting fussy.
encounters.prompt: Match each half-sentence to the right shell.
encounters.success: Contrast sets two things against each other, a condition must be met first, and a cause explains why.

items.text: whereas the north of the state is dry
items.reason: 'Whereas' sets one thing against another, so it's a contrast.

items.text: provided that the form is signed
items.reason: 'Provided that' means only if, so it's a condition.

items.text: given that the road was closed
items.reason: 'Given that' explains why something happened, so it's a cause.
'Even though' sets up a surprise against what you'd expect, so it's a contrast.
'As long as' means only if, so it's a condition.
'Because' gives the reason why something happened, so it's a cause.
